research_question: Can source-authenticated E011 trefoils generate a nonzero universal Swirl-Clock monopole from incompressible Euler alone, and how does this compare to a separately postulated Gaussian-kernel scalar EFT?
objective: Three explicit lanes: H0 Euler-only zero scalar monopole, H1 imposed massless scalar-field inverse-square unit test, H2 intrinsic PKLSA to clock source/normalization bridge. Distinguish conditional EFT identity from physical derivation.
null_hypothesis: The prescribed Euler pressure-source integral has zero monopole, and no derived scalar charge/mass normalization is available.
alternative_hypothesis: E011 finite-core knots supply a cutoff-independent nonzero clock monopole, composition-blind coupling, and inverse-square force with no inserted Newton G.
assumptions: E011 static geometry is not DYNAMICS_READY
Localized solenoidal Euler velocity fields and vanishing boundary flux yield zero pressure-source monopole
H1 scalar EFT has a deliberately postulated source charge Q=1 per normalized knot (not a mass)
H1 scalar stiffness kappa=1 and lambda=1 are dimensionless mathematical unit tests, not physical SST constants
Scalar potential follows 3D Laplace Green function; mechanical force requires test-object coupling
No physical value of G is inserted into either candidate solver
Blindness applies to integrity, not withheld experimental results
Two providers are independent geometric inputs, not independent experiments
